heroic.name: Cataclysm
heroic.description:
After 2 seconds, Deathwing flies in the targeted direction, dealing 90~~0.04~~ damage on impact and leaving scorched ground that deals 36~~0.04~~ damage a second. Lasts 6 seconds.

trait.name: Aspect of Death
trait.description:
Deathwing is fitted with 4 Armor Plates which grant 10 Armor each. Every 25% Health lost causes Deathwing to lose a plate. Plates are only restored when Dragonflight is used, based on the amount of Health Deathwing has when landing.

Deathwing is also a mighty Dragon Aspect who is permanently Unstoppable and deals 100% additional Spell Damage to Heroes, but views his allies with contempt and ignores any of their friendly effects.

mount.name: Dragonflight
mount.description: After 3 seconds, fly into the sky, becoming Immune to all effects and gaining 2.5% Health per second. Once cast, this ability cannot be interrupted. Cannot be cast for 6 seconds after taking damage, Basic Attacking or casting an Ability.

activable.name: Bellowing Roar

activable.name: Elementium Plating
activable.description:
Activate to gain a Shield equal to 30% of Deathwing's missing Health for 8 seconds. While the Shield holds, Deathwing regenerates 2% of his maximum Health per second. 

When the Shield expires or is destroyed, Deathwing regains Armor Plates appropriate for his new Health.

The Shield and effect end immediately if Deathwing uses Dragonflight.

level1.name: Dragon Soul

Reward: Once Particle Grenade has hit 40 enemy Heroes, its radius is increased by 15%.

level1.name: Together We Are Strong
level1.description: For 3 seconds after gaining Shield Ally, every 5.35~~0.04~~ damage done by the bearer contributes 1 Energy to Zarya, up to 40 Energy per Shield.

level1.name: Feel the Heat
level1.description: Zarya's Basic Attack deals 50% additional damage to enemies in melee range. While above 40 Energy, Zarya's Basic Attack size is increased by 35%.

level1.name: Maximum Charge
level1.description:
Regen Globes now instantly grant 20 Energy.

Quest: Spend 150 seconds at or above 50 Energy.

Reward: Gain an additional 20 maximum Energy.

level4.name: I Am the Strongest
level4.description:
Personal Barrier absorbs an additional 140~~0.04~~ damage. 

Passive: Damage absorbed by Zarya's Shields contributes 20% more Energy.

level4.name: Give Me Twenty
level4.description:
Quest: Regeneration Globes increase Shield Ally absorb amount by 15, up to 300 permanently. 

Reward: After collecting 20 Regen Globes, permanently reduce the cooldown of Shield Ally by 2 seconds.

level4.name: Speed Barrier
level4.description: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.

level4.name: Defensive Shielding
level4.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier and Shield Ally grant 75 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks for 6 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

level7.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
level7.description: Particle Grenade deals 25~~0.04~~ more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

level7.name: Deep Burn
level7.description: Hitting a Hero with Particle Grenade causes Basic Attacks against them to generate 2 Energy. Lasts 4 seconds.

level7.name: Explosive Barrier
level7.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier explodes, dealing 110~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies.

level10.name: Graviton Surge
level10.description: Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30~~0.04~~ damage a second.

level10.name: Expulsion Zone
level10.description: Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124~~0.04~~ damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.

level13.name: Unstoppable Competitor
level13.description: Personal Barrier makes Zarya Unstoppable for up to 2 seconds.

level13.name: Spell Barrier
level13.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier grants Zarya 75 Spell Armor for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken from Abilities by 75%.

level13.name: Endurance Training
level13.description: While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya gains 20 Armor, reducing all damage taken by 20%.

level13.name: Pain is Temporary
level13.description: Activate to consume all Energy and gain a Shield that absorbs 0.8% of Zarya's maximum Health per Energy consumed and lasts for 3 seconds. Zarya may only have one personal Shield active on herself at a time.

level16.name: Cleansing Shield
level16.description: Causes Shield Ally to remove all disabling effects and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

level16.name: Gain Train
level16.description: Shield Ally now grants an untalented Shield to a nearby ally upon impact.

level16.name: Born in Battle
level16.description: While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya's cooldowns regenerate 25% faster.

level20.name: Gravity Kills
level20.description: Increases Graviton Surge's duration by 1 second and it Silences Heroes caught in its area.

level20.name: Clear Out
level20.description: Reduce Expulsion Zone's cooldown by 25 seconds and increase its duration by 1.5 seconds.

level20.name: Grenadier
level20.description: All Particle Grenade charges are returned at once.

level20.name: Unyielding Defender
level20.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Personal Barrier and Shield Ally.

commonAbilities.name: Summon Mount
commonAbilities.description: After Channeling for 1 second, gain 30% Movement Speed.

commonAbilities.name: Hearthstone
commonAbilities.description: Show off your Hearthstone animation!

objectives.title: Capture Points
objectives.description: Control points activate occasionally. Stand within them to capture them. Fully capturing a point grants you control of a giant mech.

objectives.title: Control the Protector
objectives.description: The Triglav Protector mech is controlled by two players: one pilot and one gunner. Work together!

objectives.title: Destroy Everything
objectives.description: The Protector's Abilities deal incredible damage to Structures and Heroes alike. Use it to lay waste to your enemy.

BioticEmitter.name: Biotic Emitter
BioticEmitter.description: Create a Biotic Emitter that restores 40% of nearby allied heroes maximum Health and Mana over 10 seconds.

basic.name: Binding Roots
basic.description: Roots roots roots

basic.name: Mega Smash
basic.description: Slam the ground, dealing 0 damage to nearby enemies and stunning them.

KingsCore.name: Core
KingsCore.description: Powerful, substantially tough structure. Deals high splash damage and has a shield that regenerates while not being attacked. Destroying this structure will result in victory.

basic.name: Rocket Fist
basic.description: Launch a Rocket Fist that deals 150 damage to the first Hero in its path. The rocket pushes away and Stuns Heroes for up to 2 seconds.

MercDefenderMeleeBruiser.name: Henchmen
MercDefenderMeleeBruiser.description: Tough, high-Health Mercenary. Attacks at melee range. Specializes in soaking up attacks from enemy fortifications.

basic.description: Breath a cone of flame, dealing 85 damage and burn the area of effect for an additional 160 damage over 4 seconds.

basic.name: Savage Charge
basic.description: After a short delay, charge an enemy Hero to knock them back and deal 450 damage.

heroic.name: Rubble Maker
heroic.description:
Increases damage to Structures and Minions by 100%.
Reduces damage from Structures by 60%.
Permanently Unstoppable.

basic.name: Queen's Curse
basic.description: After a short delay, turn enemy Heroes in an area into plant zombies for 3 seconds, making them unable to attack, use Abilities, and slowing them by 30%.

basic.name: Overgrowth
basic.description: Spawn an Overgrowth that disables nearby Structures.  You deal 100% bonus damage to Structures affected by Overgrowth.  Slowly loses Health over 25 seconds.

basic.name: Sprint

trait.name: Leave Garden Terror

basic.name: Charge
basic.description:
Charge a target and deal 160 damage in an area. 

Non-Heroes take 500% increased damage.

basic.name: Rocket Fist
basic.description:
Launch a Rocket Fist that deals 150 damage to the first Hero or Structure in its path. The fist pushes Heroes for up to 2 seconds and disables Structures for 4 seconds.

Instantly kills Minions in its path.

basic.description: Gain 25 Armor and Shield nearby allied Heroes for 500. Lasts 3 seconds.

basic.name: Gatling Cannon
basic.description:
Toggle to fire missiles at the cursor's location. Each missile deals 38 damage but drains 1 Energy. Reactivate to stop firing.

Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Vector Targeting
Draw a line on the ground, dealing 60 damage. After 1 second, it explodes for 380 damage.

objectives.description: Periodically multiple Warheads will spawn across the battleground.

objectives.title: Collect Warheads
objectives.description: Collect a Warhead to activate your Nuke. Use it quick or you will drop it when you die!

objectives.title: Call Down the Thunder
objectives.description: Launch Nukes to burn enemy team's fortifications.  Attack their structures to extend the burn!

MapMechanicNuke.name: Nuke
MapMechanicNuke.description: After 3 seconds, launch a Warhead dealing 1750 damage (30% max Health to Heroes).  Sets buildings on fire, causing additional damage over 10 seconds.  This effect is extended by attacking burning buildings.
